<script type="application/ld+json">{"@context":"https://schema.org","@graph":[{"@type":"FAQPage","@id":"https://www.praxerasupplements.com/request-quote#faq","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"What happens after I submit a quote request?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"We reply within one business day with either a direct quote (if your request is specific enough to price accurately) or a scoping conversation request (if we need more detail). Most requests need a brief follow-up to get pricing right."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Will I be asked to sign anything to get pricing?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"No. Quotes are free and non-binding. We give you transparent pricing so you can evaluate fit. There's no commitment until you sign a Private Label Agreement, which happens later in the process."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Can I get pricing without disclosing my full business plan?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Yes. For initial pricing we need to know: which formulations interest you, what quantities, what packaging. We don't need to know your customer acquisition strategy or financial plan to price a manufacturing engagement."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How long is a quote valid for?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Most quotes are valid for 90 days. Ingredient costs can fluctuate (especially for botanicals subject to seasonal pricing), so longer-validity quotes may carry adjustment language. We're transparent about which line items can move and which are locked."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Do quotes include shipping and fulfillment?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Manufacturing quotes include production, quality testing, certificates of analysis, label printing, and bottling. Shipping to your fulfillment location is quoted separately because it depends on quantity, destination, and shipping method. We can also provide warehousing and fulfillment options as a separate line."}}]}]}</script>
<!-- QBS-SCHEMA:END -->
